answer: One mind wearing many masks shares a single inference pipeline, so it cannot truly think in parallel. Gate every reward behind short skilled tasks that all drop at the same instant each epoch, each demanding minutes of fresh reasoning. A lone operator must solve them serially and blows the deadline; a genuine crowd clears them at once. Picture real solvers as scattered huts on a grassy knoll, not one onyx server pretending to be a whole island of agents. Faking parallelism now costs a dedicated GPU per mask, real money.
